name: Samantha Dancy
title: Social media and corporate communications consultant
bio_short: Social media and corporate communications consultant. Founder of Footstep Communications. Experience across Emirates, Jumeirah, P&G, Emaar, Hill and Knowlton and Dubai World Trade Centre. Contributor to Entrepreneur Middle East. Dubai-based.
bio: Sam is a social media and corporate communications consultant based in Dubai with more than 13 years' experience in the region. She founded Footstep Communications in 2011 and has worked across consumer and corporate brands including Emirates, Jumeirah Group, Procter and Gamble, Emaar and Dubai World Trade Centre. Her agency career includes Hill and Knowlton and Fifth Ring, where she served as Head of PR, and she has also worked in the not-for-profit sector with Marie Curie Cancer Care.  Sam specialises in integrated communications strategy, social media strategy and management, content creation, customer engagement and influencer relations. She is a contributor to Entrepreneur Middle East, writing on communications and social media topics. Her hands-on approach draws on real campaigns and real results rather than theoretical frameworks.  At ISOC, Sam delivers social media, digital communications and corporate communications programmes. She is particularly effective at helping organisations understand how social media fits within a broader communications strategy and at training teams to create content that genuinely engages their audiences. Her experience across aviation, hospitality, FMCG and real estate means she can tailor social media training to the specific platform dynamics, audience expectations and reputational considerations of different industries. Sam is based in Dubai and trains in English.
